name: pumpkin-reveal
title: Pumpkin Reveal
description: Trick or treat with a real 3D jack-o'-lantern hanging from a dead branch. It turns on its rope, every hit grows glowing cracks where you struck it, and the third splits it along its ribs into curved shell pieces, orange outside and pale inside. A ghost escapes and three candies spill out: pick one, and one of them is a trick. The sounds are synthesised, off until the visitor switches them on, and an optional track can play as it bursts.
